# Agent Secure Supply Chain

> Public component 08 in the MrCakes931 Agent Intelligence Ecosystem. Defines initial contracts and validation for artifact identity, SBOM references, source provenance, and signature state.

- [README](README.md)

- [Example record](examples/supply-chain-artifact.json)

## Current capability boundary
The current code validates metadata shape and consistency only. It does not generate SBOMs, verify signatures, authenticate publishers, execute build steps, scan dependencies, or grant trust. A passing validation is not a security certification.

## Ecosystem
- [Master control plane](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-intelligence-ecosystem)
- [Public agent catalog](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-intelligence-ecosystem/blob/main/registry/public-agent-catalog.json)
- [Foundation requirements](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-foundation-spec)
- [Identity and trust contracts](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-identity-trust)

## Integration policy
Dependencies are architectural declarations until reproducible cross-repository tests prove compatibility. No MCP server or A2A endpoint is deployed by this repository.
